claim: Separation travel must be executed within typically 1 year of EAS
quote: The travel to the HOS must begin within 3 years after the last release from active duty unless authorized an extension

claim: Retirement travel time limit is 1 year after retirement
quote: A Service member and dependent must begin travel to an HOS within 3 years of the Service member termination from active duty unless additional time is authorized or approved through the Secretarial Process.

claim: Separating Marine may receive DLA and TLE (rare)
quote: DLA is not authorized... From last PDS to home or to the PLEAD. TLE not authorized: When leaving active duty.

claim: Separation travel requires honorable conditions; misconduct discharges may get limited or none

claim: HHG shipment to HOS within weight allowance; retirement weight allowance slightly different

quote: A Service member who is separated... and has served less than 90% of his or her initial active-duty enlistment... is not entitled to per diem
